talking_points: AI agents are becoming the product: Salesforce just put 37 sales tasks inside Claude, and security worries about agents are growing just as fast.
The biggest money is going into infrastructure: chips, data centres and the debt that pays for them.
Startup funding has split in two: record rounds for compute companies, and a much harder fundraise for everyone else.

industry.headline: Salesforce puts 37 sales workflows directly inside Claude
industry.what_happened: A beta plugin lets salespeople research accounts, prepare for calls and review their pipeline from inside Anthropic's Claude, using existing Salesforce permissions. Changes to the customer database still need a human to confirm them.
industry.plain_english: Instead of clicking through Salesforce screens, a salesperson can ask an AI to prep them for a call and it pulls the data. The AI does the work, but a person approves anything it changes.
industry.concept_definition: An AI system that does the work but stops for a person to approve risky actions.
industry.why_it_matters: Enterprise software firms are plugging into AI models rather than building their own. The platform-plus-model partnership is a strong commercial-awareness point for interviews.

industry.headline: Hackers used AI agents to break into 395 organisations in 48 countries
industry.what_happened: An attacker built exploits for two PaperCut flaws, then used AI agents to automate the intrusions, reaching at least 440 systems. In one burst, 11 organisations were compromised in 26 seconds.
industry.plain_english: The same AI that does helpful tasks automatically can do harmful ones automatically. One attacker can now hit hundreds of companies at once.
industry.concept_definition: Hiding instructions in content an AI reads so it does something its user never asked for.
industry.why_it_matters: AI security is one of the fastest-growing hiring areas, and plenty of roles don't need a PhD.

industry.headline: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Live, a real-time voice model that can reason first
industry.what_happened: The model holds spoken conversations in real time and can pause to reason before answering. It scored 82.6 on Artificial Analysis' speech-to-speech index.
industry.plain_english: Voice assistants used to be fast but shallow. This one can talk naturally and think through harder questions, which makes AI phone agents far more realistic.
industry.concept_definition: A standard test used to compare models; companies still care most about performance on their own tasks.
industry.why_it_matters: Call centres are a huge cost for banks and insurers, so voice AI is where you'll see job changes first.

finance.headline: JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs line up to lend billions to European AI
finance.what_happened: Big US banks are preparing to finance billions of dollars of debt for European AI projects, mostly data centres, despite investor nerves about AI spending.
finance.plain_english: Data centres cost billions, so companies borrow, like a mortgage on a very expensive building. Banks earn interest; the risk is AI demand not growing fast enough to repay it.
finance.concept_definition: Debt is borrowing and paying interest; equity is selling part of the company to investors.
finance.why_it_matters: When asked 'is AI a bubble?', mention that AI spending is increasingly debt-funded, which spreads the risk to lenders.

finance.headline: Kalshi pulls its GPU rental price market after a reported government request
finance.what_happened: Prediction market Kalshi took down a product tracking AI chip rental prices after the US Commerce Department reportedly raised national-security concerns. Commerce denies it.
finance.plain_english: AI computing power is becoming something people want to trade, like oil. Governments see it as strategic and are wary of live prices.
finance.concept_definition: The idea that GPU hours will be bought, sold and hedged like electricity.
finance.why_it_matters: It's a niche where finance, AI and geopolitics overlap, and few people understand all three.

finance.headline: Banks want AI everywhere, but most of their systems aren't ready
finance.what_happened: Banking and tech leaders said banks want to roll AI out to millions of customers but haven't built it into most core systems yet.
finance.plain_english: Old bank IT makes modern AI slow to add, and regulators want banks to explain any AI decision about loans.
finance.concept_definition: Being able to show why a model made a decision, often a legal requirement in finance.
finance.why_it_matters: Most finance AI jobs sit in the gap between demo and production: data engineering, model risk and compliance.

startups.headline: Gimlet Labs raises $300M at a $3B valuation, six months after its Series A
startups.what_happened: The AI infrastructure startup's Series B was led by Andreessen Horowitz, half a year after an $80M Series A.
startups.plain_english: Investors bought a slice valuing the whole company at $3 billion. Raising again this fast signals very rapid growth.
startups.concept_definition: Seed, Series A, B, C: each a new sale of shares, usually at a higher valuation and with more proof required.
startups.why_it_matters: Freshly funded startups are hiring, so they're some of the best places to apply.

startups.headline: AIR raises $50M to vet the add-ons AI agents use
startups.what_happened: The AI security startup raised across two seed rounds to monitor the plugins and skills companies let their agents install.
startups.plain_english: Agents gain abilities by installing add-ons, like phone apps. A dodgy one could leak data, so AIR checks them first.
startups.concept_definition: Protecting against risks in the third-party code and tools you rely on.
startups.why_it_matters: A new problem appeared and startups raised money to fix it within months. Spotting that pattern is commercial awareness.

vocabulary.definition: What investors say the whole company is worth.
An AI that takes actions, not just answers questions.
Running a trained model to get answers; the ongoing cost of using AI.
The giant cloud providers: AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.

quiz.question: A startup raises $50M at a $250M valuation. Roughly what share did investors buy?
Why might a bank prefer an explainable credit model over a slightly more accurate black box?
quiz.answer: Regulators require lenders to justify decisions and show they aren't discriminatory.

quiz.question: Name one job area that AI agents are creating demand for.
quiz.answer: AI security, deploying agents inside enterprise software, or financing AI infrastructure.
